description: The African Infrastructure Database (AID) of the African Union Development Agency (AUDA-NEPAD) is the project database behind the Programme for Infrastructure Development in Africa (PIDA) and its Virtual PIDA Information Centre. On 28 September 2026 it held 1,842 projects (647 published) in 55 African Union member states and five regions: 954 transport, 328 water, 314 energy and 171 ICT projects, including 430 road, 166 railway, 147 power interconnector, 125 multi-purpose reservoir, 111 port, 103 fibre optic cable, 90 hydropower, 72 border post, 55 airport and 42 internet exchange point projects. It separates the PIDA Priority Action Plans PAP 1 and PAP 2 and shows projects on an interactive map with a timeline. Coverage is continental; resolution is the individual project with its sector, subsector, status, stage, programme and regional economic community. Format and access: web platform and map, plus a JSON REST API (projects, sectors, subsectors, statuses, stages, stakeholders, programmes and statistics endpoints) that needs an API token. Licence: not stated. Free to view. Caveats: API use needs a token, only about a third of projects are published, and project stages are self-reported planning milestones. Simulation uses: planned cross-border corridors, interconnectors and cables for future network topology, capacity planning and infrastructure investment scenarios. Related records: no directly related records are catalogued yet.
